label: jex-dam4s-ra-1900-n3
_why: THE LAST TECH REWORK, CANDIDATE A, LONG PROBE (user, 2026-10-10: 'Try a long probe on A, 1836-1900, n=3'; BALANCE_FRAMEWORK §10.96, FINDINGS F223). Book config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-ra.json = jex-dam4s (the artmerge arm's book) + research_levers: the innovation cap's literacy term 150 -> 50 (country_literacy_rate in 00_code_static_modifiers) and the universities' innovation x0.5 (07_government: 1/1.5/2 -> 0.5/0.75/1), + dams.staff_per_50 pinned to 50/100/50 so the book differs from F222's MEASURED book only in the research levers. The cap is the main tool; the university cut keeps universities' share of expenditure from shrinking (user). A FIXED n=3, every run plays to 1900.

_arms.ra: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-ra.json} (+ its tree twin, jex-dam4s's).

_comparison: Against jex-dam4s n=4 (20261009_193145 runs 1-3 + 20261010_042919, the same book with vanilla research levers and the same dam staffing) at 1846-1900, and vanilla n=16 (20260821_131149): world GDP per decade (§10.96's target, the 1886 break line 0.83/1.17 of vanilla), technologies held (leader, majors, all-country median; tech_census / tech_timing), research-entry completions (je_tally), universities built and their cost, play time. And against the research model's prediction for A over the same span.

_predictions.research model (F223, resEff 0.95, input: leader e4 share at 1905 ~51% against the book's 67-69% (read 1900 here); majors' median at 1886 ~105 against 109; all-country median unchanged (71 at 1900); production onsets slower. The model's own uncertainty on the majors' speed is ~15%, and it holds literacy, universities and GDP fixed - the chain effects (slower techs -> later rungs -> later research-entry marks -> fewer grants) are NOT in it, which is what this probe tests
_predictions.universities: fewer university levels than the book (the cap is lower and each level produces half): roughly 0.6-0.8x the book's levels for the cap-bound majors
_predictions.GDP: 1846-1876 inside the book's spread; 1886 within the break line (0.83-1.17 of vanilla); lower than the book's 1.06-1.07 at 1886-1896 if fewer technologies reach the economy

_stop_rule: none: a fixed n=3, every run plays to 1900. Only a hard harness failure (crash loop, mod not loaded) stops it.
_cost: 3 runs x 1836 -> 1900, about 1.5-2 h each, about 5-6 h
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Do NOT edit tools/testbed/save_state_summary.mjs, tools/emit_research_levers.mjs, tools/emit_dams.mjs, tools/emit_research_events.mjs or the book while the batch runs.
Save summaries are v18 (innovation, cap, spreading techs) - F222's runs are v17, so innovation compares against the model's estimate there.
